issue_context.title: when unknownContext 'require' encounters object shorthand syntax, it generates invalid code
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

**What is the current behavior?**

I imported the `vm2` package in my project, and then i found the code generated was invalid.

I found this line caused this problem

https://github.com/patriksimek/vm2/blob/3.9.4/lib/main.js#L1338

`require` function was used in object shorthand syntax

**If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.**

pack flowing code:
```javascript
const obj = { require }
```
got:

```javascript
const obj = {  __webpack_require__(1) }
```

**What is the expected behavior?**

it should generate:
```javascript
const obj = { require:  __webpack_require__(1) }
```
**Other relevant information:**
webpack version:  5.59.0
Node.js version: v16.10.0
Operating System: Ubuntu20.04.3
Additional tools:
